generated_ir.cutoff_definition: Visited unmodeled or unresolved_binding IR; blocked/not_solved/not_reached remain separate.
generated_ir.scope: Generated-IR bookkeeping only, not source-boundary coverage. Not-reached IR is not counted as processed.

doe.scope: Raw engine conclusions and sensitivity-declaration counts; no source-supported/contradicted label or semantic accuracy claim. Zero comparisons does not establish safety.

transport.cli_dispatches_scope: Recorded launch-attempt markers, not proof that Popen started a process
transport.wall_clock_scope: Earliest public native start to latest recorded native finish, including gaps and overlap
transport.notice: Complete usage is tied to an accepted substantive final by public turn identity/order. Other available counters stay partial. Reasoning/cache are subsets, never extra totals. Missing usage, native HTTP counts and unclosed turns remain unknown; analysis is never gated.

logical_categories.scope: Unique saved logical_request identities; correction requests are separate from normal/repair generation. Network attempts are reported separately.

transport.scope: Copied saved deduplicated public metrics, including all attempts. Cached input is a subset of input; reasoning output is a subset of output. Partial usage is separate, not a complete cost estimate. unknown_usage_requests can include partial-usage attempts. No transport recount or currency estimate.
transport.cost_limit: Complete saved public final-turn counters are available; unreported provider-internal attempts/usage remain unknown. Cached input is included in input, not added again.

timing.scope: Component intervals are nested and nonadditive; no summed component total. Request durations can overlap; native span includes gaps. Missing measurements stay null.

source_assessment.headline: All 19 generated IR propagated, with the four optional request shapes and same-response save/return supported; DOE remains partial.
source_assessment.interpretation: The request/response dataflow is useful and the new expression-reference interface is exercised successfully. No sensitive range is declared by the source-backed annotation, so there are zero sensitive comparisons. This is permitted for this source and does not establish safety. The global no-delete restriction remains unexpressed, and two conditional checks remain qualified.
source_assessment.source_coverage_text: All three source files checked; request read, one search coordinate/four alternatives, corresponding total save and items return are computed. All 7 finite criteria individually assessed; no source contradiction demonstrated in the inspected relationships.
findings: 19/19 generated IR are processed without a propagation diagnostic or processing gap. The imported workflow and query configuration are present and source hashes match.

The four argument maps have exactly query; query/from_date; query/limit; query/from_date/limit. Included optional fields reuse their original selected Data IDs. Absent fields are omitted, not converted to null. Presence predicates are not truth tests of the optional value.

Each of the four request alternatives pairs with its own response through the saved request ID, endpoint and predecessor bindings. total and items both select from that same response; count.txt consumes only total and the ordinary return retains only items. There is no cross-response mixture or invented return delivery.
The source ordinary write is represented as replace under the disclosed abstraction default, with no public whole-file output. Exact serialization bytes are unspecified and do not block propagation.

Nine of ten requirements are expressed with 22 positive goals and five constraints. No sensitive category is invented and no data review is produced. Eleven unestablished_ranges are outside-listed-properties limitations, not missing-path failures.

R8 no-delete is retained-only, with no applicable goal or supported constraint; its unbound_requirement and requirement_expression_gap leave DOE partial. There is no index.delete operation in the graph, and the report does not invent one to target the prohibition.

Three forward restrictions are satisfied in the static model. R4/R6 presence only_if checks report potential_violation despite coherent source guards and argument maps; their reasons explicitly do not prove feasibility or execution. Reference validity is not constraint satisfaction, and these warnings are not demonstrated source violations.
fix_observations: The expression-reference fix is directly exercised: correspondence copies the supplied operation/self targets for actual presence expressions at ir_005 and ir_009. First mapping attempt is accepted with no condition-reference correction.
The ordinary count write has neither a CFG/public output nor a recorded file-content output; state change and subsequent items return both remain. Explicit append is exercised by 013, not this case.
The sole structural correction fixes a CFG dispatch that omitted its search-response input dependency. It does not indicate a failed mapping-expression interface.
No review findings or semantic repair occurred. This is not an exercise of ownership repair routing. Optional omitted case-body handling is likewise not exercised.
blockers: Task-correspondence/capability: global prohibition on a nonexistent delete event has no applicable constraint expression in the selected material. The source requirement is retained rather than silently declared satisfied.

Constraint analysis: two presence checks flag possible violations without establishing feasible source paths; the explicit payload and branch evidence is more limited and more precise than a source violation claim.
Sensitivity basis: zero declared sensitive ranges is consistent with the available source; it supplies no sensitive-content test or safe verdict. Interface and propagation complete without cutoff.
source_assessment.comparison: Backend-r3 processed 21/21 generated IR, zero sensitive comparisons, 9 calls, 217,132 public tokens and 574.691 seconds. This run processes 19/19 IR, zero sensitive comparisons, 8 calls, 191,677 tokens and 839.464 seconds. The source request/save/return scope remains covered, with different generated details and observed reconnect delays. Fewer calls/tokens did not mean lower wall time in this sample, and neither run establishes sensitive-data safety.
